summary: Redefines the wire format of the Type Bit Map field in the DNSSEC NSEC record so it can cover the full space of resource record types. It was replaced by RFC 4033, RFC 4034 and RFC 4035.

eli5.summary: DNSSEC keeps a checklist of which kinds of records exist. This document made the checklist big enough for all kinds. It was replaced by RFCs 4033, 4034 and 4035.

questions: how does nsec list record types
